user.title: Connect to Shopify Store
user.description: Choose how you want to authenticate with Shopify.

data_description.auth_mode: OAuth is recommended for security. Manual token requires creating a custom app.

oauth_init.title: Shopify OAuth Setup
oauth_init.description: Enter your Shopify app credentials. You'll be redirected to Shopify to authorize access.

data_description.shop_domain: Your Shopify store domain (e.g., my-store.myshopify.com or just my-store)
data_description.client_id: Client ID from your Shopify Partners app
data_description.client_secret: Client Secret from your Shopify Partners app

oauth_authorize.title: Authorize with Shopify
oauth_authorize.description: Please authorize the app in the Shopify window that opened.

oauth_callback.title: Complete Authorization
oauth_callback.description: If the automatic redirect didn't work, paste the authorization code and state from the callback URL.

data_description.code: The 'code' parameter from the callback URL
data_description.state: The 'state' parameter from the callback URL (should be: {expected_state})

manual_token.title: Manual Token Entry
manual_token.description: Enter your Shopify custom app access token.

data_description.shop_domain: Your Shopify store domain (e.g., my-store.myshopify.com or just my-store)
data_description.access_token: Admin API access token from your Shopify custom app
data_description.api_version: Shopify API version (leave default unless you have specific requirements)
data_description.timezone_override: Override the store timezone for date calculations (e.g., Australia/Sydney)
data_description.include_test_orders: Include test orders in counts and revenue calculations
data_description.mock_mode: Use mock data instead of real API calls (for testing integration)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Shopify
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {shop_domain} is no longer valid. Please re-authenticate.

reauth_oauth.title: Re-authorize with Shopify
reauth_oauth.description: Please authorize the app in the Shopify window that opened.

reauth_oauth_callback.title: Complete Re-authorization
reauth_oauth_callback.description: If the automatic redirect didn't work, paste the authorization code and state.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials or insufficient permissions. Ensure read_orders scope is granted.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Shopify. Please check your internet connection and shop domain.
error.invalid_domain: Shop not found. Please verify the shop domain is correct.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Shopify store is already configured.
abort.oauth_error: Shopify returned an error during authorization.
abort.oauth_state_mismatch: Security verification failed (state mismatch). Please try again.
abort.no_auth_code: No authorization code received from Shopify.
abort.token_exchange_failed: Failed to exchange authorization code for access token.

init.title: Shopify Options
init.description: Configure update interval and data options.

data.months_lookback: Months to Analyze for Busiest Month

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch data from Shopify (in minutes)
data_description.months_lookback: Number of months to look back when calculating busiest month
data_description.include_test_orders: Include test orders in counts and revenue calculations
data_description.timezone_override: Override the store timezone for date calculations
